annotations.title: Save a wishlist to my account

description: Moves an anonymous wishlist into the signed-in shopper's Plendio account, given its edit link or the token at the end of it. The edit link stops working once the list is saved; the list is then changed by its list_id, which the answer returns. Its share link keeps working. Requires sign-in.

edit_token.description: The wishlist's edit link, or the token at the end of it.

market.description: Market for the links in the answer: dk, se, de or no.
